mapper.sql: id, message_id, business_type, business_key, exchange_name, routing_key, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error, sent_at, confirmed_at, dead_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO local_message ( message_id, business_type, business_key, exchange_name, routing_key, payload, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error, sent_at, confirmed_at, dead_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{businessType}, #{businessKey}, #{exchangeName}, #{routingKey}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxRetryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{lastError}, #{sentAt}, #{confirmedAt}, #{deadAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM local_message WHERE ( (status = 'INIT' AND next_retry_time IS NULL) OR (status = 'FAILED' AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now})) ) AND retry_count < max_retry_count ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE local_message SET status = 'SENDING', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('INIT', 'FAILED') AND retry_count < max_retry_count AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW())
UPDATE local_message SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = #{sentAt}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SENDING'
UPDATE local_message SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('SENDING', 'SENT')

UPDATE local_message SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= max_retry_count THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'FAILED' END, next_retry_time = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= max_retry_count THEN NULL ELSE #{nextRetryTime} END, dead_at = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= max_retry_count THEN #{deadAt} ELSE dead_at END, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('SENDING', 'SENT')

UPDATE local_message SET status = 'INIT', retry_count = 0, next_retry_time = NULL, last_error = NULL, sent_at = NULL, confirmed_at = NULL, dead_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'DEAD')
UPDATE local_message SET status = 'DEAD', last_error = #{lastError}, next_retry_time = NULL, dead_at = #{deadAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('INIT', 'FAILED')
